name: SUPER SHINOBI DEN
detailed_description:
-The language of this game is English only, but there are no subtitles, and the interface is in simple English, so anyone can enjoy the game.-

A nostalgic 8-bit ninja action game with huge jumps and stylish combos!
"Chain combos to rack up score, then unleash powerful skills using that score—aim for the high score!"

This is a simple and exhilarating side-scrolling action game inspired by classic ninja games like Legend of Kage.
Wield the ultimate blade and six powerful ninja arts to rescue the kidnapped princess across five diverse stages.

The game features a unique scoring system where you chain actions to earn points and spend those points to unleash powerful skills.

Combos are built by performing various actions such as defeating enemies, deflecting attacks, or slicing through environmental objects. The score you earn becomes the resource for activating ninja arts.

From flashy "hack-and-slash" style runs where you just cut down everything in your path, to carefully planned high-score strategies and speed runs where you manage your score to keep the [invincibility & speed] Boost active—this game offers fun for players from ages 5 to 100.

Each stage offers a variety of enemies and satisfying boss battles.
"Easy to clear, hard to master"—perfect for players who enjoy refining their runs.

Key Features

  • Playable in about 30 minutes – Quick and replayable. The main goal isn’t just to finish the game, but to optimize your route and technique for a better score.

  • Retry instantly – Get knocked down during a stage or boss fight? Get right back up where you left off. But beware—your score will be halved upon revival.

  • Six unique skills:

    • Shuriken: A quick, low-cost ranged attack

    • Mega Shuriken: Auto-seeks nearby enemies

    • Fire Jutsu: Slow-moving flame that doubles as a shield

    • Healing Jutsu: Restores health

    • Lightning Jutsu: Full-screen attack, but very costly

    • Boost: Grants invincibility and speed-up, but drains score over time
      Use them wisely to extend combos and maximize efficiency!

  • Hidden destructible objects – Slash vending machines, signs, and more to discover bonus score items scattered throughout the stages.

  • Satisfying high jumps – The ninja can leap to impressive heights. Explore vertically to find secrets and score bonuses.

  • Authentic 8-bit style – Custom-made pixel art, font, sound effects, and chiptune soundtrack—all handcrafted by a solo developer.
